'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Pakistan floods]]
**At least 21 people are killed in [[flood]]ing caused by heavy monsoons in [[Pakistan]], including eleven in [[Gilgit-Baltistan]] and ten in [[Karachi]], as the death toll for the flooding season increases to over 400. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/8/20/at-least-21-killed-in-pakistan-torrential-rain-flooding (Al Jazeera)]
*At least 47 people and 300 cattle are killed, 70 others are injured and over 56,000 are displaced during flooding in [[Niger]]. [https://www.africanews.com/2025/08/21/flooding-in-niger-displaces-tens-of-thousands-and-leaves-at-least-47-dead/ (Africanews)]
*At least 15 people are killed and ten others are injured in a landslide in [[Manéah]], [[Kindia Region]], [[Guinea]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/at-least-15-killed-in-guinea-landslide-cba39ea7 (''Barron's'')]
*Six people are killed in an accident in a [[confined space]] at a dairy farm in [[Weld County, Colorado|Weld County]], [[Colorado]], United States. [https://abcnews.go.com/US/colorado-dairy-farm-fatalities/story?id=124860031 (ABC News)]
*At least five people are killed and 34 others are injured, including one critically, in an explosion at a fireworks storage facility in [[Karachi]], [[Sindh]], Pakistan. [https://www.geo.tv/latest/619774-blast-at-karachis-ma-jinnah-road-firecracker-warehouse-injures-25 (Geo News)] [https://www.dawn.com/news/1932442 (''Dawn'')]

**Five bodies and ten body parts are recovered and 27 suspected mass graves are discovered at the site of the [[Good News International Ministries]] religious cult mass-murder suicide at the [[Shakahola Forest]] in Kenya, where over 400 bodies were recovered two years ago.
